narrative.details:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, adventurer, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.
narrative.offerRewardText: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...<Hamuul peers into the shard>Oh... I didn't... Well.adventurer, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
narrative.requestItemsText: May I help you with something?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 25 to 26, 7,150 XP in all.

quests.name: The Glowing Shard
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard. Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.
